text: Nonprofit based in Burlington that raises capital for and develops affordable housing and invests in community economic development, including energy-efficiency work.

name: Lake Champlain Chamber
text: Regional chamber of commerce for the Burlington and Lake Champlain area, listed as a non-profit member of Energy Action Network.

host_name: New England Grassroots Environment Fund (Grassroots Fund)
name: New England Grassroots Environment Fund (Grassroots Fund)
text: Regional funder that gives seed and grow grants to small community environmental and climate groups and supports them through practice-sharing and convenings.

name: Northern Forest Center
text: Regional nonprofit working across the Northern Forest on rural community development, wood-based energy and markets, and outdoor recreation, with Vermont staff and projects in the Northeast Kingdom.

name: Regulatory Assistance Project
text: Nonprofit that advises regulators and policymakers on clean-electricity, grid and electrification policy; its US home office is in Montpelier.

name: ReSOURCE
text: Nonprofit with stores in Burlington, Williston, Barre and Morrisville that reuses donated goods and runs job training in construction, HVAC and weatherization.

name: Weatherization 101 training - Rutland
text: ReSOURCE job-training program in weatherization listed for this date in Rutland.

name: Sustainable Heating Outreach & Education
text: Small Vermont nonprofit, based in East Calais, that provides education and outreach on sustainable home heating.

name: The Nature Conservancy in Vermont
text: Vermont chapter of The Nature Conservancy, which has protected over 300,000 acres, stewards dozens of natural areas and runs a conservation grant program.

name: Vermont Adult Learning
text: Adult-education nonprofit offering basic skills, GED and English-language classes and workforce programs, including an Energy Works program.

name: Vermont Futures Project
text: Nonprofit that uses data to bring people together on economic development, environmental sustainability and social justice; it published a statewide Economic Action Plan in January 2025.

name: Vermont Green Building Network
text: Nonprofit founded in 2002 that promotes green design, construction and building operation through tours, networking and educational events; it sponsors the Burlington 2030 District.

name: Building Science and Beer Autumn Gathering
text: Autumn networking gathering of the Vermont Green Building Network.

name: Vermont Independent Power Producers Association
text: Trade association of independent power producers in Vermont.

name: Vermont Land Trust
text: Statewide land conservation nonprofit that works with farmers, woodland owners and communities to protect land, and hosts public events and workshops.

name: Winter Preview: How and Where to Recreate This Winter
text: Online talk on where to recreate on conserved land this winter.

host_name: Vermont League of Cities and Towns
name: Vermont League of Cities and Towns
text: Membership association of Vermont's cities and towns that provides advocacy, training, insurance and technical help to local governments.

name: Vermont Outdoor Business Alliance
text: Statewide nonprofit of outdoor-recreation businesses, active in networking, workforce development and advocacy, including a Climate Outdoors Workforce Initiative.

name: 8th Annual Vermont Outdoor Economy Summit
text: Annual gathering of outdoor businesses, nonprofits, educators and policymakers, with workshops, an award and an outdoor pitch competition; tickets required.

name: Vermont Sustainable Jobs Fund
text: Montpelier nonprofit that supports Vermont's sustainable economy through business accelerators in clean energy and forestry, business coaching for energy contractors and the Farm to Plate network.

name: 16th Annual Farm to Plate Network Gathering
text: Two-day gathering of the Farm to Plate food-system network.

name: Vermont Works for Women
text: Winooski-based nonprofit that trains women and gender-expansive people for careers in construction and the trades and helps employers hire inclusively.

name: Gather & Give art market and fundraiser
text: Evening art market and fundraiser supporting Vermont Works for Women.

name: Trades meet-up in Burlington with HELM
text: Meet-up for women, trans and gender-expansive people working in the trades.

name: Craftsbury Energy Committee
text: Town committee whose mission is to guide Craftsbury and its residents toward a more sustainable energy future; it meets at Craftsbury Town Hall.

name: Northfield Energy Committee
text: Northfield town energy committee that holds monthly public meetings, with agendas and minutes posted on the town website.

name: Williston Energy Committee
text: Volunteer town committee in Williston that promotes energy saving, weatherization, electric vehicles and window-insert builds, and helped organize the 2026 Williston Green Fair.

name: Bristol Energy Committee
text: Town committee in Bristol that meets monthly; the town lists agendas, minutes and video for its 2025 and 2026 meetings.

name: Hartford Energy Commission
text: Hartford town commission working to cut the town's energy needs 30 percent by 2030, with a climate action plan and a newsletter for residents.

name: South Burlington Energy Committee
text: City energy committee in South Burlington that meets monthly, with agendas and minutes posted on the city's Agenda Center.

name: Greensboro Energy & Climate Action Committee
text: Town committee working for an equitable transition to a sustainable energy future through home energy efficiency, clean energy projects, education and community action.

name: Norwich Energy Committee
text: Norwich town committee that runs outreach on weatherization and solar, plans town building energy upgrades and works with Upper Valley partners; 2026 meetings are held on Zoom.

name: Jericho Energy Task Force
text: Jericho town energy task force that held public meetings through 2026, with agendas posted on the town's Agenda Center.

name: St. Johnsbury Energy Committee
text: Town of St. Johnsbury energy committee that publishes monthly agendas for its public meetings.

name: Starksboro Energy Committee
text: Town committee working with residents, businesses and the town on long-term energy independence, including benchmarking town buildings and offering free energy-savings kits.

name: Starksboro Energy Committee meeting
text: Public meeting of the Starksboro Energy Committee.

name: Huntington Energy Committee
text: Selectboard-appointed committee that promotes energy savings through conservation, efficiency and renewables, supports home weatherization through the Energy Navigators program and is updating the energy section of the Town Plan.

name: Huntington Energy Committee meeting
text: Public meeting of the Huntington Energy Committee.

name: Stowe Energy Committee
text: Official Stowe town energy committee; its March 27, 2025 meeting took place at the Akeley Memorial Building.

name: Hinesburg Energy & Climate Action Committee
text: Hinesburg town committee on energy and climate action, with agendas posted for its 2025 and 2026 meetings.

name: Shelburne Climate & Energy Committee
text: Town committee that works on the Shelburne long-term energy future per the Town Plan, with projects on renewable-energy requirements for new construction, low-income weatherization and rooftop solar on town buildings.

name: Arlington Energy Committee
text: Committee formed in 2019 to help Arlington residents, businesses, schools and town government cut energy use and costs through conservation, efficiency and renewable energy.

name: Brandon Energy Committee
text: Subcommittee of the Brandon Planning Commission created in 2018 that wrote the town energy plan and helped put solar panels on the police department.

name: Climate Advocates Bennington
text: Bennington residents affiliated with 350Vermont who work for a sustainable future, a livable planet and climate justice.

name: 350Chittenden County Node
text: 350Vermont node of activists who meet regularly and host events in the Burlington area to educate and organize for climate justice.

name: Earth Matters Manchester
text: Southern Vermont climate-justice group and 350Vermont node that raises awareness of climate change and ways to reduce its effects; it is the environmental committee of MoveOn Manchester.

name: 350Rutland County Node
text: 350Vermont node working for climate justice in Rutland County through a school orchard and pollinator garden, a bicycle exchange and tree planting in Rutland City.

name: 350Addison County Node
text: The Middlebury-area node of 350Vermont, advocating for climate justice and a just transition for Vermont.

name: Families Rise Up
text: Group of central Vermont families organizing together toward a just transition, listed as a 350Vermont node.

name: 350White River Node
text: 350Vermont node organizing in Bethel, Randolph, South Royalton and nearby towns for a just transition off carbon-based fuels.

name: 350Montpelier Node
text: 350Vermont node of activists in the Montpelier area who mobilize and educate people to act for climate justice.

name: Climate Action Collective (students)
text: 350Vermont-sponsored student group, mostly from UVM, Champlain College and St. Michael's College, that develops student solutions to the climate crisis.

name: Vermont Racial Justice Alliance
text: Black-led Vermont organization working to dismantle systemic racism through organizing, education, policy and wellness programs; it signed the 2022 letter supporting Vermont's environmental justice law and has published a Justice Agenda tied to climate action.

host_name: Rural Environmental Justice Opportunities Informed by Community Expertise (REJOICE)
name: Rural Environmental Justice Opportunities Informed by Community Expertise (REJOICE)
text: Coalition project that held 19 community conversations across Vermont from 2017 to 2021 and whose findings informed the state's 2022 environmental justice law. No activity after 2023 was found.
